metadata.scope: Eccentric disc cams, plate cams, four-bar linkages, slider-cranks, scotch yoke, Geneva mechanisms.

material_suggestions.use_case: printed or machined cam and linkage arms
material_suggestions.notes: Self-lubricating at pivot contacts; low friction; dimensionally stable.
Good strength-to-weight; easy to drill pivot holes.
Through-harden to HRC 50 for cam lobe wear surfaces.
PETG for light-duty; PA12 for functional with metal pivot pins.

standards_used.name: Grashof condition
standards_used.note: s + l < p + q for at least one link to rotate fully.

standards_used.name: ISO 286-1 fits
standards_used.note: H8/f7 for running clearance at pivot pins; pin bore = pin_d + 0.2 mm.

output_policy.openscad_code: Geometry-only OpenSCAD with named parameters, one module, and no prose.

parts.name: Eccentric disc cam
design_rules: bore subtracted at [eccentricity, 0, 0] not at origin
keep eccentricity ≤ cam_diameter/4 to retain wall
set-screw is radial cylinder from edge toward bore
validation_criteria: bore at eccentricity offset not at center
disc is single cylinder in union
difference has bore and optional set-screw
failure_modes: bore placed at disc center — not eccentric
eccentricity so large bore breaks disc wall

constraint_checks.message: Eccentric cam bore must be offset from disc centre by eccentricity.
